author: hdprajwal
abstract: Dispatches one focused agent per independent problem and runs them concurrently — for multiple unrelated test failures, several broken subsystems, or parallel investigations with no shared state. Covers identifying independent domains, writing self-contained agent briefs, dispatching in parallel (Agent calls or a Workflow), and reviewing for conflicts before integrating. Adapted from obra/superpowers' dispatching-parallel-agents skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
